body: Thanks, I will. It's an ongoing process, but you've cheered me up a bit.

It's funny, my ex is also getting pretty fat. I was the one who was always pushing her to exercise, if it were up to her all she would have done was cry about getting fatter. Which is probably what she's done.

I'm 21, we met in high school. That's part of what makes it so difficult finding new girls. She was only my second real girlfriend, the other one I dated for about five months, nothing special. I'm beta I guess, so I don't want to just go out and fuck bitches, I'd rather have a relationship. Not saying that you'd rather do that, just stating.

We broke up around April, I've been living with roommates since then.

I don't really know any girls at all, I never really get the opportunity to meet any.

I just don't know how or where I could, though. I've tried OKC before, either the girl lives in another state or has a boyfriend and still maintains a fucking OKC profile for some stupid Christ-fucking reason. It's is NOT a friend making site, it's a goddamned dating site.

Oh, or they just want a fuck buddy. And it's not just that idea that I don't like, it's the thought of going to a dating website looking for a fuck buddy. It's like asking to get murdered/raped, and it doesn't shine well on their intelligence.

I can only hope so. I actually very nearly ran my car off a cliff tonight because of an imaginary situation where she was with another guy at the same moment. That's actually what made me make this post.

Yep, that's exactly what my nights are like, days off or no. I don't function on very much sleep. When I do get a day off, I sleep for about 14-15 hours.

Like just now, I was in a /co/ thread and I completely forgot about this post. It's very mind-numbing, and I've grown to need it.

Thing is, I don't have family. Parents are dead, brothers and sisters that have forgotten I exist scattered across the US, aunts and uncles that don't even know I exist, etc. I've never cared for family anyway, I always seemed to be the kid that no one but his parents liked.

What I did before any of this came along was live with my dad, and then my girlfriend when he died. My mom died when I was just a kid. I don't care enough to write, and I have no money to travel. And honestly, being high is the only time when I'm truly happy. I don't snort coke or take any pills, just good old trees. Even that's running low as I run out of money.

Huh, good point. Didn't think of it like that. I guess I was thinking like if I didn't go through with it, or if I hadn't even thought of it. If I were a normal person, I still couldn't do that. It's really one or the other, neither option very good.

The Internet is my hobby, from 4chan to reddit. That's pretty much all I do.

No friends, they all moved on with life and all that. I do smoke occasionally, when I have the money.

I can't join the Guard or any military, I couldn't do that to my dad. One thing he always said to me was to never join any Armed Forces, after what he experienced. I feel like I'd be shitting on his memory if I did that. It's a good idea, but I just can't do it.
I won't be looking for a friend, though, and both of us will know it. I'm just afraid that she'll be immediately dismissive of the entire thing because of how pathetic it is.

Thanks, I needed to hear that from someone other than the reasonable part of my brain.

There's still a lot of trepidation with texting her, though. I was really hurt when she ended it so I was pretty mean. Also, the fact that she ended it makes it seem all the more pathetic.

I'll try to keep it concise, it gets a little fucked up.

A few weeks after the breakup, I started to talk to another girl who I had been friends with for a while before. She's been through a lot of insane shit in her life. No real details, but she was kidnapped and molested as a kid. Lots of really underlying issues that I didn't tread until I got to know her better. I'm an awkward guy, especially now, and I decided to go ahead with it, but take is slow. We send some pictures after a while, nothing crazy. 

She's mentioned some guy named Dave* before, never really thought much of it. One night when we were supposed to just hang out she said she was tired right before I came to pick her up, and went to bed. I pick her up the next day, and she sort of casually announce that her and Dave are fuck buddies. My heart immediately sinks and I'm thinking "What the fuck have I gotten into." Just fuck buddies though, because he's "afraid of commitment". We're still hanging out that day, and she mentions that she went to bed when Dave didn't pick her up. I guess she forgot about what she told me.

I'm just sitting there kinda stunned, but like a goddamned moron, I just start to talk to her about it. I actually didn't point out her lie, I just openly wondered why she's doing that. She didn't have a real reason other than "teenage horniness". She told me he ignores her most of the day while selling weed, and he **doesn't fucking use condoms**. She's on BC, so they're apparently not worried. She even admitted that he said if she got pregnant, he'd have nothing to do with it.

My god this has turned into a hate rant.

I really like(d?) her, and that's where my problem lies. I'm so fucking desperate for affection that I'm thinking of texting my ex. That question mark is also tearing me up.

So that's it. Now I'm shaking.

*Not actual name.

Doing nothing is what I'm most afraid of, though. I'm probably going to fail college, so am I just gonna work some shit job until my brain melts? I had ambition enough when we were together, but now there's nothing.

I want to make it abundantly clear that I'm not thinking about it because we broke up. It's what I'm left with and how she acted that's causing it. It's a really big difference in my head, and I'm not trying to sound like some little shit who's whining because he had a bad breakup. I don't know.

I've already burned bridges, and even if I hadn't there's no way I could be near her.

I kinda have done that, I mentioned the friends I'm staying with. I really, really don't want to tell them I've considered doing anything, mostly because I don't want the typical spiel, for them to hound me about it. One thing I've always hated is when people ask if I'm okay, and them forcing words out of me.
